The {{PAGENAME}} is a resource gathered at the {{Item|Marble quarry}} in the north part of the [[Quarry]]. The {{PAGENAME}} needs to be stored at the {{Item|Stone stockpile}} to then further process it with the {{Item|Stone cutter}} or {{Item|Stone cutter II}} to get {{Item|A piece of marble}}
